title: Fix a bug
body: Reproduce first, then fix, so you know the fix is real.
prompt:
#[file] #[test file]
Bug: [what happens] when [steps]. Expected: [what should happen].
First add a failing test that reproduces it. Then fix it with the smallest change.
Don’t change: [public API / other modules].
Done when: the new test and all existing tests in [folder] pass.
Reply in 5 lines max: cause, fix, files changed.

title: Plan a feature
body: Agree the plan, then implement it one step at a time in Agent.
prompt:
/plan [Feature in one sentence].
Users: [who]. Must: [requirements]. Must not: [limits].
Relevant code: #[file] #[file]
Give me: files to change, steps in order, risks, and what to test. No code yet. Max 20 lines.

title: Refactor safely
body: Behaviour stays the same, and the tests prove it.
prompt:
#[file]
Refactor [function/module] to [goal, e.g. remove duplication / split into smaller functions].
Behaviour must not change. Keep the public signatures.
Run [test command] before and after and show both summary lines.

title: Write tests
body: Name the cases you care about, or you get the obvious ones only.
prompt:
#[file]
Write [framework] tests for [function].
Cover: happy path, [edge case], [edge case], and invalid input.
Follow the style of #[existing test file]. No snapshot tests.
Run them and fix only the tests, not the code, unless you find a real bug. Tell me if you do.

title: Explain unfamiliar code
body: Ask for the level of detail you need, and keep it short.
prompt:
#selection
Explain what this does for someone new to [area].
Then list: inputs, outputs, side effects, and anything surprising.
Max 10 lines.

title: Review my changes
body: A quick second pair of eyes before you open a PR. Save it as a prompt file.
prompt:
#changes
Review these changes as a senior engineer.
List at most 8 issues, most serious first: bugs, missing tests, security, naming.
One line each with file and line. No summary, no praise.

title: Fix a failing command
body: Hand over the output by reference, not by pasting.
prompt:
#terminalLastCommand
The command above failed. Find the root cause and fix it.
Don’t change [config/dependencies] without asking.
Re-run the command to confirm and show the last 5 lines.

title: Commit message
body: Or use the sparkle button in the Source Control commit box.
prompt:
#changes
Write a commit message: a summary line under 60 characters in the imperative, a blank line, then up to 3 bullet points on why. No file lists.
